patch_description: Structural redesign around an explicit candidate-pipeline architecture. Instead of the previous monolithic staged search, the program is organized as a pipeline of independent refinement operators (sanitize/normalize, sphere soft-opt, exact SLSQP packing with pre/post validation, and a new antipodal 7-pair reparameterization that halves the search space and enforces central symmetry). A beam of candidates flows through the pipeline, with each operator returning a validated (points, score) result; the driver simply composes operators and keeps the global incumbent. The antipodal stage exploits the fact that optimal 14-point packings tend toward antipodal symmetry, giving a much smaller, better-conditioned optimization problem that can push the ratio above the reference value. Robustness guards (shape/finite checks before any optimizer call) are centralized in the sanitize operator.
